title: Kabuki Klash
note: Neo Geo fighting game: health, timer, magic gauge, 8 of its 12 characters.

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: Neo Geo 68000 RAM seen from 0x100000, bytes swapped within 16-bit words

credits.note: MVS credits (backup RAM), readable in MAME only

p1_mode.note: BIOS: player 1, 0 never played, 1 playing, 2 continue, 3 game over

bios_request.note: BIOS_USER_REQUEST: 2 demo, 3 title screen (asked by the BIOS when a coin goes in on an MVS)

bios_timer.note: BIOS_COMPULSION_TIMER: seconds left on the title screen before the game starts by itself

bios_mvs.note: BIOS_MVS_FLAG: 0 home console (AES, no coins), otherwise arcade (MVS)

_in_p1.note: BIOS_P1CURRENT: the stick and buttons of player 1 (bit 0 up, 1 down, 2 left, 3 right, 4 A, 5 B, 6 C, 7 D), read at every frame ("fast") for the moves recognised at the stick (1.39); read the other way round if up and down show together

_in_p2.note: BIOS_P2CURRENT: the stick and buttons of player 2, same bits

_p1_chr.note: player 1 character (the robot's recording of 2026-11-15: the only fixed byte, with the same number 0xDF bytes into the fighter's object, that follows the fighter named on the screenshots; 0 Manjimaru, 5 Ziria)

_p2_chr.note: player 2 or computer character, the byte after (the robot's recording of 2026-11-15: 4 Yagumo, 2 Tsunade)

power.note: magic gauge of player 1 in %, full = 0x3C, 0x6E bytes into the fighter's object (MAME cheat database, Infinite Magic; the robot's recording of 2026-11-15: full when the MAGIC bar of the screenshots is)

power_p2.note: magic gauge of player 2 or the computer in %, full = 0x3C

health.note: player 1 health in %, full = 0x64, 0x56 bytes into the fighter's object. The object changes place at every round: the game keeps where it is at 0x105094 (the robot's recording of 2026-11-15: 100 at each of the nine round starts, the bar of the screenshots; the fixed place 0x100E56 was right in the first round only). A K.O. takes it below zero, read 0xFF: from 0xB2 it reads empty

health_p2.note: player 2 or computer health in %, the same way, its object kept at 0x105098 (the robot's recording of 2026-11-15)

rounds.note: rounds won by player 1 (RetroAchievements code notes, 0x50e9 --PLAYER ROUND WIN--, the byte next to it in the 68000's order), gold stars under the bars and the winner of a round; to confirm in game (1.31.1, K.O. audit)

rounds_p2.note: rounds won by player 2 (RetroAchievements code notes, 0x50e8 --CPU ROUND WIN--, the byte next to it in the 68000's order), gold stars under the bars and the winner of a round; to confirm in game (1.31.1, K.O. audit)

time.note: timer (BCD), from 99, the number of the screenshots (the robot's recording of 2026-11-15; 0x103A16 was not the timer)

score_p2.note: player 2, to find with learn.bat (two-player game, score2=...)

p1_char.note: 0, 2, 4 and 5 read on the screenshots of the robot's recording of 2026-11-15; 8 to 11, the four bosses, from the cheat database (Select Character). 1, 3, 6 and 7 are not known yet: no name is shown for them

specials.note: special moves and supers of each fighter, shown under a human player's name (1.38): from the command list of MAME (command.dat 0.273, Fabricio Coroquer and AntoPISA), made by tools/command_dat.py
